description: Cheapest-tier thin wrapper around prediction.hip4_price_ladder - use this when you only need one strike's Yes probability, not the full ladder. Returns the single rung closest to the requested strike - check matched_strike against your requested strike before relying on yes_price; a large gap means no rung exists near your target (use hip4_price_ladder to see what's actually available). Paid in USDC on Base.

strike.description: Target price to look up - the closest available rung is returned.

underlying.description: Asset symbol for crypto price-binary markets (e.g. 'BTC', 'ETH', 'SOL', 'HYPE').

name: prediction.hip4_price

matched_strike.description: The closest available rung's strike - NOT guaranteed to equal requested_strike.
